global.copy_error: Copy failed. Select and copy the text manually.
global.error: Unable to complete this request. Check your connection and try again.
global.name: Name
global.access_denied: This operation is not permitted for this account or portal.
global.api_unavailable: This service or resource is unavailable. Check access and portal configuration.
global.quota_exceeded: The storage or resource quota has been reached.
global.conflict: The server state changed. Refresh and verify before trying again.
global.page_diagnostics_help: Inspect your browser environment and the connected server.
global.saved: Preferences are saved on this device.
global.token_payload_help: Explore the session claims returned by AuthCrunch. Expand objects and arrays to inspect their contents.
global.token_payload_note: Viewing claims does not verify a token signature.
global.token_payload_error: This payload cannot be displayed as a tree. You can still show or copy the original value.
global.token_method_other: An authentication method defined by the identity provider.
global.token_claim_amr: Authentication Methods References: the methods used to sign in. Several methods can appear together.
global.token_claim_acr: Authentication Context Class Reference: the assurance context assigned by the identity provider.
global.token_claim_iss: Issuer: the service that issued the token.
global.token_claim_sub: Subject: the identity this token represents.
global.token_claim_aud: Audience: the services this token is intended for.
global.token_claim_exp: Expiration time, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
global.token_claim_iat: Issued-at time, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
global.token_claim_nbf: Not-before time: the token is not valid before this Unix timestamp.
global.token_claim_auth_time: When authentication occurred, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
global.token_claim_jti: Token identifier: a unique identifier for this token.
global.token_claim_sid: Session identifier: the sign-in session associated with this token.
global.token_claim_roles: Effective roles carried by the session.
global.token_claim_authenticated: Authentication status reported by the portal.
global.token_claim_expires_at_utc: Expiration time formatted by the server in UTC.
global.token_claim_issued_at_utc: Issue time formatted by the server in UTC.
global.token_claim_not_before_utc: Not-before time formatted by the server in UTC.
global.token_method_otp: A one-time code, such as a code from an authenticator app.
global.token_method_hwk: Proof of possession of a hardware-protected key.
global.token_method_swk: Proof of possession of a software-protected key.
global.token_method_federated: Sign-in through an external identity provider.
global.token_method_user: A check that the user is physically present.
operator.overview_help: Manage identity stores, local accounts, authentication rules, and portal signing keys.
operator.reload_help: Reload this identity store from its database. In-memory changes may be replaced.
operator.reported_policy_help: These are backend-reported policy settings. Reported flags alone do not prove enforcement.
operator.create_user_help: Create a local account. The server generates its password; save it after creation.
operator.local_email_help: Use a matching stored email. Leave empty only for a provisioned account without local email aliases.
operator.uncertain_create_help: Creation may have completed. Check the current account list before retrying.
operator.account_exists_help: This account exists. Open it and reset its password if the generated password was not received.
operator.disabled_info_help: Disabled accounts cannot be read through the info API. Enable the account from the user list first.
operator.roles_help: One role per line. Role changes use stored roles before portal transforms.
operator.rules_help: One ordered rule per line, such as password totp. Alternatives use or; conditions use if … not available. At least one rule is required.
operator.invalid_rules_or_roles: Enter valid, nonempty roles or authentication rules.
operator.mutation_review_help: An unsuccessful write may have changed state. Read the current account before retrying.
operator.credential_inventory_help: Counts only. Stored secrets and password verifiers are not displayed.
operator.reset_password_help: Replace this account’s password with a server-generated password. Save the result securely.
operator.generated_password_help: Save this generated password securely. It is only held in memory and is not available from account details.
operator.disable_help: Block future sign-ins while retaining this account and its connections.
operator.enable_help: Re-enable this account with its exact stored username and email. Previous login evidence remains invalid.
operator.delete_user_help: Permanently remove this account. A connected external identity may provision a new account on its next login; disable the account to block sign-in.
operator.private_export_help: Private export requires explicit server enablement and eligible asymmetric signing keys. Exported material is not passphrase protected.
operator.private_export_confirm: Private signing keys can mint trusted tokens. Download only to a secure location and restrict access to the exported file.
operator.configuration_note: Runtime configuration is managed in Caddy. This console manages the operations exposed by the AuthCrunch API; it does not edit server configuration.
operator.system_service_help: The system API accepts encrypted machine-to-machine assertions. System keys and authentication plaintext are not submitted from this console.
